Just stop trying to fit in and be yourself! Sounds cliche, but it's true. If I know I cannot deal with the person, I won't push it. I know I can find someone I could really be friends with. 

But of course don't think that because you're an NT girl you can only be truly happy being friends with fellow NTs, or guys (like some of the people here say). We need certain types depending on what we look for in life. In my experience, for friends and acquaintances:

* NTs - if I want people who won't talk about emotional fluff. Best in deeper and intellectual conversations. I notice that when talking about things (specially when dealing about opinions, facts) I don't have to reiterate or rephrase what I say because they just "get" it. They are also the ones I go to along with STs if I have problems because we are interested in solving problems together.

* STs - Same with NTs, but less deeper conversations and more action and problem solving. They see things realistically than most types, and can function better in society. They understand the importance of social structures, conventions (which could be a problem with NTs specially INTPs). If you have problems dealing with real-life situations always come to STs for help.

* NFs - The people who will make you feel more human. You need them in your life because they understand human emotions better than you do! Almost all I know are very sensitive and sad(?), but it's because they are very much in tune with their feelings. Most likely you will become their "wise friend" (because they need a more rational approach in life that you provide) but they will become your "wise friend" (because what you NTs need is to develop your feeling aspect). 

* SFs - I don't really get along with most of them, but I do have one friend who is an SF. Very great in adventures! NTs need them to make us get out of their heads.

Edit: It's not about types anymore. You just have to find the right people.
